notes: v15 EXPERT MODE: ab Dost ke teen modes hain — Normal, Driving, Expert. (1) Console mein upar Mode ki line + Normal/Driving/Expert buttons; Settings mein bhi wahi selector — tap se mode badlein. (2) Expert dabane par field picker: Manager (pehla, tayyar pack — routine anchors, standing instructions, Daily Operations Report wala kaam), Developer, Cook, Plumber, Buyer, Delivery Rider, Driver, ya koi aur hunar (khaali pack jo aap sikha dein ge). (3) Expert on hote hi AAJ KI BRIEFING: aaj ke tasks + dhyaan wali cheezein. Awaaz se: 'expert mode on karo', 'driving mode', 'normal mode karo', 'aaj ki briefing do', 'aaj ka kaam jodo: ...', 'mere aaj ke kaam batao', '... kaam ho gaya'. (4) Routine auto-switch: Manager pack mein duty 1:00 PM aur end 9:00 PM set hai — waqt par Dost POOCH kar Expert on karega aur duty end par khud Normal. Ghar se nikalne (Driving) ka waqt abhi sikhaya nahi gaya — is liye Driving abhi sirf tap/awaaz se on hoga, khud nahi. (5) Driving mein ghair-zaroori screen wala kaam note ho kar arrival briefing mein milega; 'Ruko' har cheez foran rok deta hai aur auto-switch ko bhi us window mein rok deta hai. (6) Nayi kaam ki baat seekhne par Dost pehle POOCHTA hai, phir pack mein permanently save karta hai (pack sirf is phone par rehta hai). NOTE: doosri AI apps ko khud chala kar kaam karwana (router) abhi NAHI aya — wo agla phase hai. Ye foundation hai: modes, packs, briefing, tasks, auto-switch.
